title: Motion Feel Lab
user: Indie animators and game/UI makers translating a desired motion quality into an editable curve.
smallest_useful_product: A static playground with six descriptive motion intents, editable position and rotation curves, onion-path preview, 2/4/8-frame comparison, and CSS/JS export.
constraints: Descriptive labels must not claim universal emotional meaning
No character rigging, physics simulation, generative animation, or video export
